book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: 2 Timoti Poloye Timoti mapoo to hee hoguguloso tenee

content: Poloye Timoti mapooto hamameedee kokodo taka

Yesu Kelisoye mipoo hamapoo wiligi odoo doloso badalame see wedi siboga, yayo odoo susuga epedee gie hagee do sabolo, osoloso odoo wedia sabolo dia goo midileiso. Esiga ayo Yesu Kelisowo howo woola, osoloso Godeeyo howo woola, namapoo ka taka, nayo to tekepo ee odoo mapoo eligilame. Osoloso Godeeyo to dulei goomegeli odoo mapoo, osoloso Godeeyo to dulei goweli odoo mapoo nayo Godeeyo to medee takee. Egeeseelone edebeeyo gamenee eligi goo mapoo tei toga, nayo diba to tekepo sabolo tei eligi goo mapoo see ido sibo dolone ka badebee. Osoloso diayo see goo tokenee teyaga, Godeeyo toso diba medee pidilone ka badebee. Osoloso nayo dimapoo Godeeyo to eligilone, medee mesie sabolo dimapoo kitulugu tenelone badebee.

Bei, odoo aboso to tekepo eligi goo mapoo gowoolai biame ee sibileiso. Egeeseelone dieso goomoga goo ee dodolone, eligili odoo abo ee gilimado sibileiso, to diayo dulei goomoga goo ee dimapoo eligilame.
Egeeseelone, diayo tei eligi goo ee poogoloso see gesaboo oposusu mapoo medee dulone dabalaiso.

Esino goo susuga ee ma kulodu, no tei goo ono kibiya kookoodoloso, no nediliyo nee su kookoodoloso badolone, dala ma kulodu kibiya badebee. Osoloso to tekepo eligilone badolone, tou susuga Godeeye namapoo tenee ee medee temelee.
Esiga Timoti, ayo namapoo kokodo taka. Bei, edebeeyo a wooloomaloso mipoo hagee poogoo dilei biame olo koola tooboo.
Esino tou Godeeye amapoo tenee ee medee kibiya tomo sibileso hosudooso. Egeesi ma kulodu ayo tei too ee medee kibiloso badoso.

Esiga ayo Godeeyo howo woola tekepo badeli goo maga, yayo Kei mi ma dokodoo mopoodoo doloso magoo nei oso a bamoloso. Esiga goo medee teiba midili odoo Lodeeye siboga, nei ee amapoo tenelaiso. Osoloso yayo nei hedebe amapoo tenelai mauwe. Haye, odoo agayo yayo sibilei mapoo bolone goomoga sabolo doga, diba onosee nei talaiso.
Timoti, ayo hagee bado mapoo saga sibilame, no weegeegee.

Bei, odoo abolo badeli Dimaseeye mi toowa eyo goo goomoga maga, a poogoloso see Tesalonika mi mapoo diso. Esino Kelesekeseeye Galesia mi mapoo Godeeyo tou talame diso. Osoloso Taites onosee Dalamatiya mi mapoo Godeeyo tou talame diso.
Egeesi ma kulodu hedebe Luka ono abolo hamapoo badoso. Esiga nayo amapoo sibulone Maka ido sibeye. Bei, yayo mo tou pidiliga.
Esino ayo Tikikus Epeses mi mapoo diye diso.

Esiga Timoti, nayo siboga, mo kekeisu dugo kali Tolowasee mi mapoo, Kalopuseeyo moso mapoo deedee poogoo ee tosibeye. Osoloso mo booka onosee tosibeye. Osoloso nayo mo booka gala koloso moodoo ee tosibilei, a diya goomogo.
Egeesi ma kulodu ki biso bi moodoogali odoo hee Alesandaye amapoo dala toowa tenemeleeso. Esino Lodeeye yimapoo nei dala tenelaiso.
No obeeyamo, nayo odoo ogono medee ege. Bei, iyo eligi goo ee yayo diya wegigeliso.

Esiga ayo daga malalo goo midili mapoo pala biame omapoo, odoo heeso a pidilame abolo pele. Esino odoo susuga oso a poogoo diso. Esino ayo Godee mapoo taka, yayo dibada goo tokenee ee hapoloso boobado bigilame.
Esino Lodeeye a pidilone abolo badebei maga, goo midili odoo oso a teli mapoo tenele. Esino ayo to tekepo ee Yu odoonee goo midili mi koola mapoo tebisamelee mapoo takalame, yayo a pidiso.

Esiga edebeeyo amapoo dala tenelame seega, dala ee ma kulodu Lodeeye a pidileiso. Osoloso yayo a Kei mi ma dokodoo ido palaiso. Esiga odoo susuga oso biame susuga hedebe Godee mapoo mesilone yimapoo goomoga poudilei tekepo. To hagee tei goo.
Esiga ayo emegei di to ee Plisila sabolo, osoloso Akwila mapoo takoloso, see Onesipolos sabolo, osoloso o moso kulodu debeli odoo mapoo takee.
Elastuseeye Kolin mi mapoo osee badebeiso. Osoloso Tolopimus yo paiye neme, ayo yo Miletus mi mapoo hologooso.

Esiga dugo telega mologa, no sibilei eli esialoso ayo hagee bado mapoo sibilame weegeegee. Yubulus sabolo, osoloso Pudes sabolo, osoloso Linos sabolo, osoloso Kalaudiya sabolo, osoloso tei telaga odoo susuga sabolo, oso diayo emegei di to ee namapoo takooso.
Ayo Godee mapoo taka, Lodeeye nobolo badalame, osoloso yayo niba sooloo dolone pidilame.
